definitions.origin_and_axes: world origin is the room polygon's first vertex; x/y follow the supplied world frame; z is up from floor
definitions.facing: listener forward direction in world coordinates (north=+y, east=+x, south=-y, west=-x)
definitions.wall_index: zero-based polygon edge from vertex i to vertex (i+1) modulo vertex count; vertices are counterclockwise
definitions.aim_vector: unit vector from speaker toward its acoustic/visual forward direction
definitions.position_m: mount point projected to the wall plane; position_xy optimizer points are offset inward by the search nudge
definitions.optimizer_position_xy_m: optimizer's horizontal acoustic candidate, nudged into the room for a valid image-source computation
definitions.candidate_data: stored separately when --save-candidates is supplied; each row is a wall-u and height-grid sample
